summary_en: As of 10 October 2026, a total of 12 confirmed yellow fever cases, with four deaths, have now been reported in Venezuela during 2026; in the states of Aragua, Barinas, Delta Amacuro, La Guaira, Lara and Monagas. Yellow fever has also been detected in monkeys along the country's jungle corridors. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 17 October 2026, a total of 76,784 dengue cases (59,728 confirmed) and 81 deaths have now been reported in Peru during 2026. Serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2 and DENV-3 have been identified. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 17 October 2026, a total of 91,419 dengue cases (64, 333 confirmed) and 69 deaths have now been reported in Columbia during 2026. Serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4 have been identified. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 19 October 2026, a total of 121 yellow fever cases (19 confirmed), with three deaths, have now been reported in the Upper West Region of Ghana. The outbreak response, including an emergency vaccination campaign, continues. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 21 October 2026, a total of 4,004 suspected dengue cases (including 311 confirmed and 11 deaths) have been reported in Chad during 2026. Six provinces have been affected: Ennedi Ouest, Batha, N'Djamena, Ouaddaï, Sila and Wadi Fira. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 25 October 2026, a total of 10,060 confirmed Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases and 4,887 deaths have been reported in The Democratic Republic of Congo. Eight provinces have reported cases: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, South Ubangi and North Ubangi. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

As of 23 October 2026, 4,588 confirmed measles cases have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions in the United States, during 2026. This exceeds the number of cases reported for the whole of 2025 and is the highest number of measles cases reported in the US for 35 years. The highest number of cases have been reported in Pennsylvania (1,327), followed by South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on measles.

As of 27 October 2026, a total of 1,548 cases (227 confirmed cases and 30 deaths) have been reported in Zambia since the cholera outbreak was declared on 28 July 2026. Cases have been reported across 18 districts in six provinces with the highest numbers reported in Lusaka and Chibombo districts. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on cholera.
As of 19 October 2026, a total of a total of 70,140 dengue cases have been reported in India during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 14 October 2026, a total of 23 yellow fever cases, with 11 deaths, have now been reported in Côte d'Ivoire for 2026. An outbreak response, including an emergency vaccination campaign, is ongoing. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on yellow fever.

As of 23 October 2026, a second Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) death has been reported in Kenya. This second fatal case was a direct close contact of the first case imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. All nine confirmed Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases in Kenya are linked to this index case and there is no evidence of community spread. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

On 22 October 2026, French health authorities reported the first ever known case of Shamonda virus (SHAV) infection in a human. The case was severely immunosuppressed and died in early October. Some brain complications prior to his death were likely linked to the infection. It is thought that the individual contracted the virus following a bite from a midge in the East of France, where the virus has been been circulating in animals (mainly cattle) since spring/summer 2026. Local health authorities have advised there is no risk to the general population at present as this appears to be an isolated and exceptional case. Please see World Organisation for Animal Health for further details on Shamonda virus.

The World Health Organization have reported 1,669 suspected cases (71 deaths) of Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF) across Afghanistan, Jan-Sept 2026. 220 cases were reported in September alone. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on CCHF.

As of 14 October 2026, a total of 18 Usutu virus cases have been reported in seven regions of Italy during 2026. Of these, eight have been reported in Lombardy, three in Lazio, two in Veneto and Marche and one case in each of Emilia-Romagna, Friuli-Venezia Giulia and Piedmont.
One case of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) has been detected in Kenya, during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on polio.

title_en: Ebola disease in Nigeria ex Uganda & DRC
summary_en: On 20 October 2026, according to the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare of Nigeria, one case of Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) has been confirmed in the Federal Capital Territory, in a woman with a recent travel history to Uganda. According to the Ugandan Ministry of Health this individual had travelled through Uganda from DRC. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

On 15 October 2026, the US Embassy and Consulate in Morocco stated that on 28 September 2026, the Ministry of Health of Morocco reported a small diphtheria outbreak, with clusters in multiple regions in Morocco. Health teams are tracing contacts and providing preventive treatment and vaccines. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of seven cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Albania during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of seven cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Bulgaria during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 16 October 2026, a total of three cases of locally acquired West Nile virus have been reported in Slovenia during 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.
